name: TOTP Enrollment Flow Integration Proof
summary: Registers integration proof that the real authentication flow service, typed TOTP enrollment handlers and AppUserMfaManager execute the canonical begin and confirm enrollment outcomes.
notes: AuthenticationFlowService, both TOTP enrollment handlers and AppUserMfaManager are real instances in the proof harness.
The confirm proof derives a real current TOTP from the secret produced by the real begin operation rather than mocking verification.
IAppUserRepo and ISecureStorage are mocked as infrastructure boundaries only.
Runtime execution status remains separate from this authored test binding.

sourceReferences.note: Canonical server integration evidence source for TOTP enrollment begin and confirm.
Extracts AptixEvidence metadata from the compiled test assembly for runtime evidence generation.
